description: This file defines a conversation store for MS Teams proactive messaging, including types for conversation references, store entries, and store interface methods.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Method to insert or update a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Method to retrieve a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to list all conversation store entries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Method to remove a conversation entry by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Method to find the most recent person-targeted conversation reference for a user.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Deprecated method to find a conversation reference by user ID; use `findPreferredDmByUserId` instead.
